text.en: Atlas original classroom sound design study, docs/64. A schematic five-station bench with no audio. Sound controls250/500Hz and relative amplitude1/2; fixed250-fold wave slowdown, scene wavelength250/f, maximum displacement0.035×amplitude. Propagation teaching speeds340/1500/5000m/s for air/water/chosen uniform solid. Reflector distances17/34/68m; one-way milliseconds1000d/c and echo milliseconds2000d/c when transmission exists. Echo display slowed10-fold; default34m gives100ms one-way and200ms return, displayed over2s. Source-off times and all vacuum propagation quantities are null, not zero. Static instrument forms and moving markers are schematic.
text.zh: Atlas原创课堂声音设计研究，见docs/64。无声音播放的五工位示意台架。频率250/500赫兹、相对振幅1/2；纵波固定慢放250倍，场景波长250/f，最大位移0.035×相对振幅。空气/水/选定虚拟均匀固体的教学声速为340/1500/5000米每秒。反射面距离17/34/68米；有传播时，单程毫秒数1000d/c，回声毫秒数2000d/c。回声显示慢放10倍；默认34米得到单程100毫秒、往返200毫秒，画面显示2秒。停源时间与真空传播量为null，不是零。乐器静态结构与局部运动标记均为示意。

note.en: Original DESIGN/SIM, not measurements. Equations independently implemented; no branded instrument, physical loudness calibration or hearing test. Air/water approximate speeds follow S16; uniform solid5000m/s is deliberately chosen, not a universal property.
note.zh: 原创设计与模拟值，非实测。不对应品牌乐器，不校准真实响度，也不作听力测试。空气与水速度约值来自S16；均匀固体5000米每秒是设计选择，不是普遍物性。

text.en: OpenStax Physics13.1, Types of Waves: mechanical waves require matter; sound can propagate through gases, liquids and solids. In longitudinal sound, local medium motion lies along propagation; a travelling wave is distinct from matter moving from source to receiver.
text.zh: OpenStax Physics13.1《波的类型》：机械波需要物质，声音可经气体、液体和固体传播。纵向声音的介质局部运动沿传播方向；传播的波不同于物质从声源迁移到接收处。

text.en: OpenStax Physics13.2, Wave Properties: frequency is cycles per second, hertz is its unit, amplitude is maximum displacement from equilibrium, and wavelength is spacing between adjacent equivalent phases.
text.zh: OpenStax Physics13.2《波的性质》：频率为每秒循环次数，以赫兹为单位；振幅为离开平衡位置的最大位移，波长为相邻同相位置之间的距离。

text.en: OpenStax Physics14.1, Speed of Sound, Frequency and Wavelength: sound speed depends on medium and conditions; speed equals frequency multiplied by wavelength. At fixed wave speed increased frequency shortens wavelength. The string example holds other conditions fixed when comparing vibrating lengths.
text.zh: OpenStax Physics14.1《声速、频率与波长》：声速取决于介质及条件，波速等于频率乘以波长；波速固定时，提高频率会缩短波长。弦长比较例子保持其他相关条件相同。

text.en: OpenStax Physics14.2, Sound Intensity and Sound Level: for comparable conditions greater amplitude corresponds to greater intensity; perceived loudness is a hearing response and is not identical to displacement amplitude. Frequency relates to pitch; the bench does not calibrate decibels or loudness ratios.
text.zh: OpenStax Physics14.2《声强与声级》：条件相近时，振幅较大对应声强较大；主观响度是听觉感受，不等于位移振幅。频率与音高有关；实验台不校准分贝或主观响度倍数。

text.en: OpenStax Physics14.4, Sound Interference and Resonance: resonance gives a stronger response near a natural frequency; air-column length affects wind-instrument pitch; a sounding body helps couple string vibration to air.
text.zh: OpenStax Physics14.4《声音干涉与共振》：驱动频率接近固有频率时响应较强；空气柱有效长度影响管乐器音高；共鸣体帮助把弦的振动传给空气。

text.en: WHO, Deafness and hearing loss: Safe listening,6March2026. Reduce sound level, limit loud exposure, move away from loud sources, use suitable hearing protection and take quiet breaks. Persistent ringing or difficulty following conversations warrants professional attention. Enjoying music does not remove exposure risk.
text.zh: 世界卫生组织《耳聋与听力损失：安全聆听》，2026年3月6日：调低声音、限制高声暴露、远离巨大声源、适当护耳并到安静处休息。持续耳鸣或难以跟上对话，应寻求专业意见。喜欢音乐不能消除暴露风险。

text.en: US NIH NIDCD, Noise-Induced Hearing Loss: an intense brief impulse or long/repeated loud exposure can damage hearing. Changes can be temporary or permanent and can become apparent gradually. Favourite music can be harmful when exposure is excessive.
text.zh: 美国国立卫生研究院NIDCD《噪音性听力损失》：强烈短暂脉冲，或长时间、反复接触高声，都可能损害听力；变化可能暂时或永久存在，也可能逐渐才被察觉。喜欢的音乐在过度暴露时同样可能有害。
